description: Asks to give one person in the workspace another role: member, admin or owner, named by their user id (list_members gives ids and roles) or the email address they sign in with. Only an owner can change roles, the workspace always keeps at least one owner, and nobody changes their own role this way. Nothing happens until you approve it in CodeGene: the answer gives a link to the request, which waits there for 15 minutes. Send the person that link; you cannot approve it. Then call get_approval with the requestId to learn how it ended. Once approved, their new role applies at once, and a lower role cancels each invitation of theirs still waiting that the new role could not send (an admin made member keeps none).

member.description: The person: their user id from list_members, or the email address they sign in with.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

role.description: Their new role: member, admin or owner.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: change_member_role
title: Change someone's role in the workspace
